name: Aurasense open ledger
about: Every dollar that comes in to Aurasense, where it came from, and which needs it met. Shown to everyone. The page https://www.aurasense.app/ledger is drawn from this file.
order_out: The floor: the founder's needs, by kind only (everyday living, a quiet home, a safe vehicle)
never_shown: A giver's name, unless they chose to be named
A person's own needs by name, without their consent
Bank, card or account numbers, or anything that would let someone find a person
Anything people say in the Mirror or in Aura Accords
rules: Each payment is added as it comes in, from the payment records
Amounts are exact here and shown to the nearest dollar on the page; totals are added from the exact amounts
A mistake is corrected as a new dated line that says what changed, never a silent edit
Data is never sold and never named
Clean sources only: money earned by adding to war, to harm to the living earth, or to deeper inequality is not accepted, from people or from AI; what cannot be accepted is returned
